tasks.label: Inspect app configuration
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Force ai-job-match; if (Test-Path ai-job-match\package.json) { Get-Content ai-job-match\package.json }; if (Test-Path ai-job-match\README.md) { Get-Content ai-job-match\README.md -TotalCount 120 }; if (Test-Path ai-job-match\requirements.txt) { Get-Content ai-job-match\requirements.txt -TotalCount 80 }

tasks.label: Check available Streamlit
tasks.command: Get-Command py,python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Source; py -m streamlit --version 2>&1; python -m streamlit --version 2>&1

tasks.label: Run AI Job Match app
tasks.command: py -m streamlit run ai-job-match\app.py --server.headless true --server.address localhost --server.port 8501
